Ride Posters

An experiment in turning cycling data into bespoke artwork: each trip drawn as one circular elevation profile, ride after ride.

Three days out of Albuquerque: around the Sandias to the Crest, over the Turquoise Trail to Santa Fe and up toward the ski area, then one we played smart. September 2018.
